ELECTRICITY — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning DC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for DC Generators.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after DC Generators.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for DC Generators.

2. When learning Electrical Diagrams, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Diagrams.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Diagrams.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Diagrams.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Diagrams.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

   D. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.

8. When learning Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Information and Communication Technology

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

11. When learning Single Phase AC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

12. When learning Wiring Systems and Regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wiring Systems and Regulations.

13. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

14. When learning Electronics 4.4 Project Identification, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Single Phase AC Generators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
